messages:
inc-bot: [ALERT] billing-ingest-queue size = 12,400 (> 10k threshold) for 2h. Symptoms: delayed usage tallies, duplicate partial records. Pager: @oncall-payment.

alex_g: ack — I'm taking primary. Oncall handoff: I'm the payment on-call for next 60m.

maria_k: I'm in billing team, pulling the ingest consumer logs now. Seeing lots of S3 503s to the raw bucket around 03:12-03:40 UTC.

samir_r: data-engineer here — we've got a retry storm from the consumer after transient gateway errors. Some messages re-ingested with missing token metadata; that explains token-count drift.

alex_g: quick assessment: customers marked as overage in `billing-alerts` started around 04:00 UTC. We should mute downstream overage alerts while we reconcile. Paging ops: @jess_et can you mute `billing-overage` rule?

jess_et: on it. Muted for 45m and added note: 'muted while we backfill ingest and reconcile counts' :white_check_mark: 

samir_r: propose mitigation steps:
1) Pause consumer group `usage-consumer-v2` (`kafka-consumerctl pause usage-consumer-v2`).
2) Launch backfill job with dedupe and strict token extraction: `backfill-usage --start=2026-03-14T02:00Z --end=2026-03-15T06:00Z --dedupe=true --out=backfill-run-20789`.
3) Run delta-recompute for affected customers: `billing-recompute --batch backfill-run-20789 --mode=incremental`.

maria_k: agreed. I've paused the consumer and bumped concurrency for the transformer to 6 to speed parsing of the backlog.

ops_shift: I've created a temporary status page note: 'Delayed usage reporting for a subset of customers; working on backfill. No billing finalization during reconciliation.' Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2078923456

alex_g: status update: backfill job started (job id backfill-run-20789). Initial sampling shows token counts are ~0.7x for some events due to missing `token_count` field. We'll run a heuristic extractor to recover counts.

samir_r: running extractor now. Here's the extraction command + sample output:
```
python tools/extract_tokens.py --input s3://redwood-raw/2026/03/14/ --heuristics=hashmap
# sample output:
# event_id: e12345 tokens: 127 recovered_from: prompt_length
```

maria_k: reaching out to support/billing to block invoice finalization for affected accounts: support@redwood flagged accounts: [acme-inc, fastpay, ledgerly].

jess_et: billing-alerts channel updated and customer-facing ops informed. Also added temporary annotation in customer dashboards.

alex_g: note on telemetry: token-counting drift likely started after a lambda deploy that changed JSON schema (dropped `token_count`). Rolling back lambda would stop new bad events; do we want rollback?

samir_r: yes, we rolled back the deploy at 04:20 UTC. No new malformed events after rollback.

ops_shift: ETA: backfill progress 30% after 12 minutes. Queue size down to 6,800. Monitoring: `queue.len` and `backfill.progress` dashboards linked.

maria_k: after backfill completes we'll run `billing-recompute --validate-only` on sample accounts to verify recovered numbers before unmuting alerts.

alex_g: decision: keep overage alerts muted until recompute + validation complete and queue fully drained. Create incident ticket for postmortem with severity P2. Assign to: alex_g, samir_r, maria_k, jess_et. Drafting the incident notes.

jess_et: created JIRA INS-207892 with summary: 'Ingest retry storm -> token-count drift -> delayed usage reports' and linked to status page.

ops_shift: handoff to next on-call @maria_k in 30m. Leaving monitoring playbook and current artifacts in the thread. :hand:

maria_k: acked handoff. Monitoring alert shows steady drain; backfill progress 62%; queue len 3,100. I'll continue until full reconciliation or pass back to team lead.

alex_g: closing update for now. If anyone spots new overage notifications after unmute, flag here. We'll keep the thread open for postmortem notes.

inc-bot: INFO: alert resolved when queue length < 1k for > 15m — monitoring will continue for 2h.
